citation.title: A model-based, multichannel, real-time capable sawtooth crash detector
citation.authors: H van den Brand, M R de Baar, M van Berkel, T C Blanken, F Felici, E Westerhof, M Willensdorfer, ASDEX Upgrade Team, EUROfusion MST1 Team

topic: Causal, multichannel detection of sawtooth crash times in ASDEX Upgrade ECE electron-temperature data. Method: an interacting multiple model (IMM) estimator built on Kalman filters.
own_question: Can the spatial redistribution pattern across ECE channels, combined with flat-mixing crash models, detect crash times causally within a 1 kHz step budget?
actual_method_and_evidence: Profiles are represented with 11 cubic B-splines. Six hypotheses are used: no-crash (identity model) plus five mixing radii. Data: seven windows from five AUG discharges, downsampled to 1 kHz. Detection times are compared against human visual labels, with the same parameters used for all windows. All visually labeled crashes were detected, plus a few extra detections that were interpreted as partial reconnections. Mixing radius was judged poorly fitted in many cases. Timing was reported for offline Matlab/mex runs on a non-real-time OS; there was no deployment.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Recursive Kalman-type estimators have been used causally on multichannel profile diagnostics. One example is an IMM detector for sawtooth crashes in AUG ECE data.
claim_checks.qualification: This is event detection of electron-temperature crashes, not nowcasting of an impurity-ion CES report. Its labels are visual inspection, not independent truth.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs are filtered ECE channels at 1 kHz with no ion or CES data. Report arrival latency is not addressed. Sub-ms or few-ms step times are offline benchmarks, not a deployed system.
validation_if_relevant: Seven hand-selected windows with visual crash labels. There was no independent test set and no comparison against baselines.
forbidden_inferences: that it nowcasts ion or impurity temperature
that its timing transfers to our 10 ms task
that prior causal work is electrons-only or that all prior work is noncausal
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Optional one-line citation as an example of causal, model-based multichannel state estimation in tokamaks. It does not bear on the CES nowcasting target or on BES/ECEI information.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
